explicit_validation.explanation: Paper explicitly validates LLM evaluation against human evaluation using Bland-Altman analysis on 96 data points, reporting consistency metrics and percentage agreement improvements.

prompts.notes: Prompt 14 in appendix details the key-point-based evaluation prompt including scoring criteria for three dimensions (Procedure, Personalization, Proactivity) and example evaluation output formats.

guidelines.notes: Human evaluators scored outputs on Procedure, Personalization, and Proactivity using 0-5 scale; key points manually annotated by two graduate students with verification for comprehensiveness.

sample_size.notes: 16 data points per method in both Tool-Given and Tool-Retrieval settings for GPT-4o, totaling 96 data points

quantitative_scores.notes: Under key-point constraint, close to theoretical ideal value of 0
39.6 percentage points improvement compared to control group without key points

correlation_interpretation.threshold_used: Mean difference close to 0 indicates consistency

validation_results.summary_finding: Key-point-based LLM evaluation shows statistical consistency with human evaluation (mean difference 0.01) and 89.6% of samples have score differences ≤ 1 point, confirming method effectiveness.

criteria_mapping.notes: Both LLM and human evaluators use identical three-dimensional criteria with 0-5 scoring scale
